workarounds.symptom: OpenClaw adapter reads nothing on 2026.9.x: transcripts migrated to SQLite, and gateway WS tap gets scopes=[]
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(openclaw): detect SQLite session store and warn on 2026.9.x migration (#6173). Target files: clawmetry/adapters/openclaw.py, clawmetry/sync.py. OpenClaw 2026.9.x migrated live session transcripts from `.jsonl` files to `state/openclaw.sqlite`. ClawMetry's filesystem adapter only scanned for `.jsonl` files, so every sync cycle silently found nothing and activity timestamps froze — with no explanation in `sync.log`. This PR makes both the detection and the silence diagnosable. (Ref: https://github.com/vivekchand/clawmetry/pull/6174)
